{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "85a5f2bd-3589-402a-bb2e-a53fe1b71a43",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Data collection"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "4b3fa140-5612-4130-bc42-fe7058a90270",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from relife.datasets import load_circuit_breaker"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "78576593-a684-414b-80db-9172603431dc",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "array([(34.,  True, 33.), (28.,  True, 27.), (12.,  True, 11.), ...,\n",
       "       (42., False, 31.), (42., False, 31.), (37., False, 26.)],\n",
       "      shape=(4204,), dtype=[('time', '<f8'), ('event', '?'), ('entry', '<f8')])"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "\n",
    "lifetime_dataset = load_circuit_breaker()\n",
    "display(lifetime_dataset)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "b8a10f86-71fd-46ba-88f3-b92b94cdc4bc",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Datasets are Numpy structured arrays. Here, the array has 3 fields : time (float), event (bool) and entry (float)."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "8c2feeb9-6e41-4bf9-9f2e-b89e3c6f6cd9",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 640x480 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "event = lifetime_dataset[\"event\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.hist(\n",
    "    [lifetime_dataset[\"time\"][event == True], lifetime_dataset[\"time\"][event == False]],\n",
    "    bins=50,\n",
    "    histtype=\"barstacked\",\n",
    "    label=[\"complete\", \"right censored\"],\n",
    ")\n",
    "plt.legend()\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "6355e675-6ec0-49d3-b4ea-a525159e10d5",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Lifetime model estimation"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "609829e6-befc-4446-8719-0b27efa9e7eb",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We want to estimate the probability that the asset will be functionning beyond time $t$. This information is given by the survival function [1] :\n",
    "\n",
    "$$\n",
    "S(t) = P(X > t)\n",
    "$$\n",
    "\n",
    "$X$ : the lifetime of the asset (random variable)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "1530fe02-4eb4-4a79-aaa6-111329ea097c",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from relife.lifetime_models import Weibull, Gompertz, LogLogistic, Exponential"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "04265e0c-e596-40cf-bff7-9c46364def51",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[3.7267452  0.01232326]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "weibull = Weibull()\n",
    "weibull.fit(\n",
    "    lifetime_dataset[\"time\"],\n",
    "    event=lifetime_dataset[\"event\"],\n",
    "    entry=lifetime_dataset[\"entry\"],\n",
    ")\n",
    "print(weibull.get_params())"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "id": "86358c5a-0778-47e5-90ae-25587c8f4775",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[0.00390781 0.07579546]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "gompertz = Gompertz()\n",
    "gompertz.fit(\n",
    "    lifetime_dataset[\"time\"],\n",
    "    event=lifetime_dataset[\"event\"],\n",
    "    entry=lifetime_dataset[\"entry\"],\n",
    ")\n",
    "print(gompertz.get_params())"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "6dc7b168-0c66-4a96-b4a4-78a1e43ca8f1",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[3.92211849 0.0128701 ]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "loglogistic = LogLogistic()\n",
    "loglogistic.fit(\n",
    "    lifetime_dataset[\"time\"],\n",
    "    event=lifetime_dataset[\"event\"],\n",
    "    entry=lifetime_dataset[\"entry\"],\n",
    ")\n",
    "print(loglogistic.get_params())"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "id": "b4614b7a-ed8f-493a-b7a8-af702c846e4b",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[0.00463636]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "exponential = Exponential()\n",
    "exponential.fit(\n",
    "    lifetime_dataset[\"time\"],\n",
    "    event=lifetime_dataset[\"event\"],\n",
    "    entry=lifetime_dataset[\"entry\"],\n",
    ")\n",
    "print(exponential.get_params())"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "id": "a5c44ae4-9db3-4c12-b90c-27ff281355ae",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 600x500 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 5), dpi=100)\n",
    "\n",
    "timeline = np.linspace(0, 140, 100)\n",
    "weibull.plot(\"sf\", timeline, label=\"Weibull sf\", ax=ax)\n",
    "gompertz.plot(\"sf\", timeline, label=\"Gompertz sf\", ax=ax)\n",
    "loglogistic.plot(\"sf\", timeline, label=\"Log-Logistic sf\", ax=ax)\n",
    "exponential.plot(\"sf\", timeline, label=\"Exponential sf\", ax=ax)\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.legend()\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "9bbed32b-3bbb-409a-ae41-df7ba6a96f50",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### How to choose the best parametric model ?"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "id": "428b0bb9-0df5-4423-85ea-68e75c01c333",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "fitted params : [0.00390781, 0.0757955]\n",
      "AIC           : 2485.57\n",
      "AICc          : 2485.57\n",
      "BIC           : 2498.25\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "print(gompertz.fitting_results)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 11,
   "id": "c143119d-8e28-441f-b1d6-b106ebfcccd1",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "fitted params : [3.72675, 0.0123233]\n",
      "AIC           : 2493.72\n",
      "AICc          : 2493.72\n",
      "BIC           : 2506.41\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "print(weibull.fitting_results)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 12,
   "id": "da55d284-3cfc-4867-83ec-71eeb0b296df",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "fitted params : [3.92212, 0.0128701]\n",
      "AIC           : 2497.81\n",
      "AICc          : 2497.81\n",
      "BIC           : 2510.49\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "print(loglogistic.fitting_results)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 13,
   "id": "5eba4b6d-5f25-4020-9980-e747ad9fd263",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "fitted params : [0.00463636]\n",
      "AIC           : 2602.52\n",
      "AICc          : 2602.52\n",
      "BIC           : 2608.86\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "print(exponential.fitting_results)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "5e5ef782-b5ac-45c2-96f4-fa9c1bf3fd1b",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Best model minimizes the AIC. Here Gompertz is selected\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "7be35a8d-c97f-4ff8-bb0d-da0302552228",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Evaluate the performance of maintenance policies"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "a15efe84-07c0-4319-9312-f2acca42da04",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Let's compare two maintenance policies : \n",
    "\n",
    "- corrective replacement, *aka* Run-To-Failure (RTF)\n",
    "- Preventive Age Replacement (PAR)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "f13c8115-6e15-4668-b354-a647e1cf92d2",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Cost structure :\n",
    "\n",
    "- cost of a preventive replacement : $c_p = 300$ k€ \n",
    "- cost of a replacement on failure : $c_f = 1100$ k€"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 14,
   "id": "124dbe24-98dd-46aa-8a8f-d902800602f4",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "cp = 300  # k€, cost of preventive replacement\n",
    "cf = 1100  # k€, cost of failure\n",
    "discounting_rate = 0.04"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "c4ec4f10-253f-48d9-9ed4-c768f39330d4",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Creating a Run-To-Failure policy"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "1d0e9820-c1fd-4653-9818-966ad9e17fc3",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "ReLife has a module called policy that contains all the maintenance policy constructors"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 15,
   "id": "32ef1a07-9551-4864-b2bb-cc94878b297c",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from relife.policies import RunToFailurePolicy\n",
    "\n",
    "rtf_policy = RunToFailurePolicy(gompertz)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 16,
   "id": "a85983fa-391a-4aaf-b28d-b1da2f57dbcf",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Asymptotic expected equivalent annual cost for RTF : 4.49 k€\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "rtf_asymtotic_cost = rtf_policy.asymptotic_expected_equivalent_annual_cost(\n",
    "    cf=cf, discounting_rate=discounting_rate\n",
    ")\n",
    "print(\n",
    "    \"Asymptotic expected equivalent annual cost for RTF :\",\n",
    "    round(rtf_asymtotic_cost, 2),\n",
    "    \"k€\",\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "196d4ace-e8dc-45e8-a1c9-558247efba2e",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Creating a preventive age replacement policy"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 17,
   "id": "a75792bc-b67b-4a63-8d64-be492dabcccf",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from relife.policies import AgeReplacementPolicy\n",
    "\n",
    "par_policy = AgeReplacementPolicy(\n",
    "    gompertz,\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 18,
   "id": "9e583c74-aa50-40a3-bec9-f5790f5c212b",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Optimal preventive age of replacement : 55.22\n",
      "Cost for optimal ar : 3.57 k€\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "optimal_ar = par_policy.compute_optimal_ar(\n",
    "    cf=cf, cp=cp, discounting_rate=discounting_rate\n",
    ")\n",
    "print(\"Optimal preventive age of replacement :\", round(optimal_ar, 2))\n",
    "print(\n",
    "    \"Cost for optimal ar :\",\n",
    "    round(\n",
    "        par_policy.asymptotic_expected_equivalent_annual_cost(\n",
    "            ar=optimal_ar, cf=cf, cp=cp, discounting_rate=discounting_rate\n",
    "        ),\n",
    "        2,\n",
    "    ),\n",
    "    \"k€\",\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 19,
   "id": "a6985505-6669-4863-9bc3-1d7e4e7c8ae6",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 640x480 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "ar_range = np.linspace(23, 112, 1000)\n",
    "plt.plot(\n",
    "    ar_range,\n",
    "    par_policy.asymptotic_expected_equivalent_annual_cost(\n",
    "        ar=ar_range, cf=cf, cp=cp, discounting_rate=discounting_rate\n",
    "    ),\n",
    "    label=\"PAR asymptotic EEAC\",\n",
    ")\n",
    "plt.plot(\n",
    "    optimal_ar,\n",
    "    par_policy.asymptotic_expected_equivalent_annual_cost(\n",
    "        ar=optimal_ar, cf=cf, cp=cp, discounting_rate=discounting_rate\n",
    "    ),\n",
    "    \"o\",\n",
    "    label=\"Optimum\",\n",
    ")\n",
    "plt.axhline(\n",
    "    rtf_asymtotic_cost, label=\"RTF asymptotic EEAC\", color=\"C1\", linestyle=\"dashed\"\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.xlabel(\"Age of preventive replacement\")\n",
    "plt.ylabel(\"Asymptotic cost (k€)\")\n",
    "plt.legend()\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "03900c0a-1267-42b0-b64c-144bbe880565",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The best policy is the cheapest : **preventive age replacmeent at 55 years.**"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "6c22b8bc-b331-4751-8cd7-0a698148e464",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Projection of the consequences "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "6c123cb0-4eb2-47e6-9703-1e21886e75f6",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Computation of the expected numbers of upcoming replacements. This information is obtained by solving the renewal equation [4][5] (***no simulation*** :=)) \n",
    "\n",
    "$$\n",
    "\\text{Solving :} \\quad m(t) = F(t) + \\int_{0}^{t}m(t-x)dF(x)\n",
    "$$\n",
    "\n",
    "where :\n",
    "\n",
    "$$\n",
    "m(t) = \\mathbb{E}(N_t)\n",
    "$$\n",
    "\n",
    "$N_t$ is number of replacements between $[0, t]$"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "848bfbb5-f339-44c9-b0a7-2e68819c25a4",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "ReLife implements a fast solver of this equation. To project the upcoming annual replacements for the optimal PAR policy, a new object is created with optimal age of replacement and the current age distribution"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 20,
   "id": "272f3251-6bbc-4e91-9a4b-3d5c4f06e624",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "array([56., 56., 21., ..., 42., 42., 37.], shape=(4000,))"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 20,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "current_ages = lifetime_dataset[lifetime_dataset[\"event\"] == False][\n",
    "    \"time\"\n",
    "]  # ages of the assets still in operation\n",
    "current_ages"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 21,
   "id": "09e2668f-5f6e-496f-8dca-a8b6373c26d2",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stderr",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "/home/grisonwil/Code/relife/src/relife/policies/_preventive_age_replacement_policies.py:295: UserWarning: \n",
      "Some ages of replacement are inferior to assets ages.\n",
      "You may change ages of replacement.\n",
      "\n",
      "  check_impossible_replacements(ar, a0)\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "timeline, nb_replacements = par_policy.annual_number_of_replacements(\n",
    "    75, ar=optimal_ar, a0=current_ages\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 22,
   "id": "bf271c85-87c5-4f8f-a11f-0a8dc979929a",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "adjusted_ar = np.where(current_ages > optimal_ar, current_ages + 3, optimal_ar)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 23,
   "id": "a19882e2-95f7-42bc-8a4f-b1edeab0b84e",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "timeline, nb_replacements = par_policy.annual_number_of_replacements(\n",
    "    75, ar=adjusted_ar, a0=current_ages\n",
    ")\n",
    "timeline, nb_failures = par_policy.annual_number_of_failures(\n",
    "    75, ar=adjusted_ar, a0=current_ages\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 24,
   "id": "089d30a4-4da2-405a-87ce-882e8bc06d54",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "(75, 4000)"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 24,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "nb_replacements.shape"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 25,
   "id": "ed19b6a8-d928-464c-ae8f-b4fa3fe9244a",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1800x500 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(18, 5))\n",
    "ax.bar(\n",
    "    timeline + 2026,\n",
    "    np.sum(nb_replacements, axis=-1),\n",
    "    align=\"edge\",\n",
    "    width=1.0,\n",
    "    label=\"total replacements\",\n",
    "    edgecolor=\"black\",\n",
    ")\n",
    "ax.bar(\n",
    "    timeline + 2026,\n",
    "    np.sum(nb_failures, axis=-1),\n",
    "    align=\"edge\",\n",
    "    width=1.0,\n",
    "    label=\"failure replacements\",\n",
    "    edgecolor=\"black\",\n",
    ")\n",
    "ax.set_xlim(left=2026)\n",
    "ax.set_xlabel(\"Year\", fontsize=\"x-large\")\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel(\"Expected nb. replacements\", fontsize=\"x-large\")\n",
    "ax.tick_params(axis=\"both\", labelsize=12, width=1.0)\n",
    "plt.legend(fontsize=\"large\")\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "1409024e-fc3d-4b5b-8058-fdd6bf51e4ee",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### References\n",
    "\n",
    "[1] : Gertsbakh, I. (2002). Reliability theory with applications to preventive maintenance. IIE Transactions, 34(12), 1111-1114.\n",
    "\n",
    "[2] : Park, C. Contemporary Engineering Economics, 6th ed. Pearson, 2016.\n",
    "\n",
    "[3] : William G. Sullivan, Elin M Wicks et C Patrick Koelling, Engineering Economy. 2009\n",
    "\n",
